title: Glowing cheese wedge
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='42' ry='35' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- shadow under cheese -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#B8860B' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- cheese wedge - main body -->
  <polygon points='15,75 78,42 78,75' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- cheese top face -->
  <polygon points='15,75 78,42 60,30' fill='#FFEC80'/>
  <!-- cheese side face (front) -->
  <polygon points='15,75 60,30 78,42' fill='#FFC107'/>
  <!-- lighter edge on front -->
  <polygon points='15,75 60,30 78,42' fill='none' stroke='#FFE44D' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- top edge highlight -->
  <line x1='15' y1='75' x2='78' y2='42' stroke='#FFF5B8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- holes on front face -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='62' r='5' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='52' r='4' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='52' r='2.8' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='5.5' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='60' r='4' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='68' r='3' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='68' r='2' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='3.5' fill='#D4A017'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <!-- hole on top face -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='3.5' fill='#E8C020'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='2.3' fill='#FFEC80'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <polygon points='88,28 90,24 92,28 96,30 92,32 90,36 88,32 84,30' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.9'/>
  <polygon points='10,35 11.5,32 13,35 16,36.5 13,38 11.5,41 10,38 7,36.5' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='85,65 86,63 87,65 89,66 87,67 86,69 85,67 83,66' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- tiny sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='42' r='1' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='50' r='1' fill='#FFF8DC' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
